# Authentication

Token login (`/api/identity/token`), verify / resend the 2FA code, refresh. Don't script these; use the token file (see SKILL.md).

4 operation(s). Base URL `https://vannbros-qa.burqio.site`; `{version}` in a path is `1`. Calls need `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (see ../SKILL.md). **Read-only for QA:** only GETs, and not the GETs SKILL.md lists as side-effecting.

| Method | Path | operationId |
|---|---|---|
| POST | [`/api/identity/token`](#op-token-get) | Token_Get |
| POST | [`/api/identity/token/verify2facode`](#op-token-verifytwofactorauthenticationcode) | Token_VerifyTwoFactorAuthenticationCode |
| POST | [`/api/identity/token/resend2facode`](#op-token-resendtwofactorcode) | Token_ResendTwoFactorCode |
| POST | [`/api/identity/token/refresh`](#op-token-refresh) | Token_Refresh |

<a id="op-token-get"></a>
### POST `/api/identity/token`

operationId `Token_Get` · Authenticates a user and generates JWT access token and refresh token

Parameters: _none_

Request body `model` (application/json), **required**: [TokenRequest](#schema-tokenrequest)

| Status | Body | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [ResultOfTokenResponse](#schema-resultoftokenresponse) | Authentication successful, tokens generated |
| `400` | [ResultOfTokenResponse](#schema-resultoftokenresponse) | Invalid credentials or account locked |
| `401` | [ResultOfTokenResponse](#schema-resultoftokenresponse) | Authentication failed |
| `500` | [ResultOfTokenResponse](#schema-resultoftokenresponse) | Internal server error |

<a id="op-token-verifytwofactorauthenticationcode"></a>
### POST `/api/identity/token/verify2facode`

operationId `Token_VerifyTwoFactorAuthenticationCode` · Verifies two-factor authentication code and completes the login process

Parameters: _none_

Request body `model` (application/json), **required**: [TwoFARequest](#schema-twofarequest)

| Status | Body | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [ResultOfTokenResponse](#schema-resultoftokenresponse) | 2FA verification successful, tokens generated |
| `400` | [ResultOfTokenResponse](#schema-resultoftokenresponse) | Invalid 2FA code or expired verification |
| `401` | [ResultOfTokenResponse](#schema-resultoftokenresponse) | 2FA verification failed |
| `500` | [ResultOfTokenResponse](#schema-resultoftokenresponse) | Internal server error |

<a id="op-token-resendtwofactorcode"></a>
### POST `/api/identity/token/resend2facode`

operationId `Token_ResendTwoFactorCode` · Re-sends the two-factor verification code for a login already past the password step

Parameters: _none_

Request body `model` (application/json), **required**: [ResendTwoFactorCodeRequest](#schema-resendtwofactorcoderequest)

| Status | Body | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [ResultOfTokenResponse](#schema-resultoftokenresponse) | A new code was e-mailed and a fresh ticket returned |
| `400` | [ResultOfTokenResponse](#schema-resultoftokenresponse) | The ticket is missing, expired or no longer valid |
| `500` | [ResultOfTokenResponse](#schema-resultoftokenresponse) | Internal server error |

<a id="op-token-refresh"></a>
### POST `/api/identity/token/refresh`

operationId `Token_Refresh` · Refreshes an expired JWT access token using a valid refresh token

Parameters: _none_

Request body `model` (application/json), **required**: [RefreshTokenRequest](#schema-refreshtokenrequest)

| Status | Body | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [ResultOfTokenResponse](#schema-resultoftokenresponse) | Token refreshed successfully |
| `400` | [ResultOfTokenResponse](#schema-resultoftokenresponse) | Invalid or expired refresh token |
| `401` | [ResultOfTokenResponse](#schema-resultoftokenresponse) | Refresh token authentication failed |
| `500` | [ResultOfTokenResponse](#schema-resultoftokenresponse) | Internal server error |

<a id="schema-tokenrequest"></a>
### TokenRequest

Request model for user authentication and JWT token generation

Required: `email`, `password`

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `email` | string (email) | yes | Gets or sets the user's email address for authentication; minLength 1 |
| `password` | string | yes | Gets or sets the user's password for authentication; minLength 1 |
| `origin` | string |  | Gets or sets the origin URL for the request (used for CORS and security) |

<a id="schema-tokenresponse"></a>
### TokenResponse

Response model containing JWT authentication tokens and user session information

Required: `refreshTokenExpiryTime`, `isTwoFactorEnabled`, `isPasswordExpired`

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `token` | string |  | Gets or sets the JWT access token for API authentication |
| `refreshToken` | string |  | Gets or sets the refresh token used to obtain new access tokens |
| `userImageURL` | string |  | Gets or sets the URL to the user's profile image |
| `refreshTokenExpiryTime` | string (date-time) | yes | Gets or sets the expiration date and time for the refresh token |
| `isTwoFactorEnabled` | boolean | yes | Gets or sets a value indicating whether two-factor authentication is enabled for the user |
| `isPasswordExpired` | boolean | yes | Gets or sets a value indicating whether the user's password has expired and needs to be changed |
| `verificationUri` | string |  | Gets or sets the verification URI for two-factor authentication setup |
| `preAuthToken` | string |  | Gets or sets the short-lived pre-authentication ticket issued when a password check succeeds but the login is not yet complete (two-factor code still required). This is not an access token and grants no API access. It proves only that the caller passed the password step, and must be presented back to /api/identity/token/verify2facode together with the emailed code. The real access token is issued only after that verification succeeds. |

<a id="schema-twofarequest"></a>
### TwoFARequest

Request to complete a two-factor login by presenting the emailed code together with the
pre-authentication ticket returned by the password step.

Required: `code`, `preAuthToken`

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `code` | string | yes | Gets or sets the one-time verification code delivered to the user's e-mail address.; minLength 1 |
| `preAuthToken` | string | yes | Gets or sets the short-lived pre-authentication ticket returned by the login call. This binds the two-factor step to the password step: without it, the emailed code could be brute-forced by anyone who knows the user's e-mail address.; minLength 1 |
| `email` | string |  | Gets or sets the user's e-mail address. |
